# Code Anchors: Distill Run Record and Cleanup

- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-cleanup.ts` — the cleanup subcommand: the live-run refusal, the local worktree list filtered to the epic's distillation branches, each removal, and the run record deleted last.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-cleanup.spec.ts` — pins removal on every distillation branch, the not-found success, the live-run refusal, removal from inside the worktree, and that only the named epic's record goes.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.ts` — the run record folder named for the epic, the live-run marker and its process check, and the cleanup line in every ending.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.spec.ts` — pins the one-run-per-epic refusal across the epic and pull-request forms.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-exceptional-paths.spec.ts` — pins the stopped and unconfirmed endings, each naming the cleanup command.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — parses the cleanup subcommand and its single epic-number argument.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/worktree.ts` — the distillation-branch name pattern by epic number that cleanup matches worktrees against, and the worktree removal it reuses.
- `README.md` — the adopter-facing cleanup command and the run record's location.
